title: A Cut That Shifts the Frame

scenes.tts: Proteins headed for the cell surface fold inside the endoplasmic reticulum. If unfolded chains arrive faster than they can be folded, the cell needs to know. The unfolded protein response does this with three sensors. One is I R E one, which spans the membrane. When unfolded protein builds up, I R E one molecules cluster. Clustering switches on an R N A cutting activity in their cytoplasmic ends.
scenes.caption: Proteins headed for the cell surface fold inside the endoplasmic reticulum. If unfolded chains arrive faster than they can be folded, the cell needs to know. The unfolded protein response does this with three sensors. One is IRE1, which spans the membrane. When unfolded protein builds up, IRE1 molecules cluster. Clustering switches on an RNA-cutting activity in their cytoplasmic ends.
scenes.visual: An ER compartment above a membrane bar: orange chains fold into grey blobs, then chains pile up faster than they fold. Two IRE1 sensors span the membrane, slide together, and their cytoplasmic blades turn red.

scenes.tts: In its best-known job, I R E one cuts a segment out of one messenger R N A. In animals, that message is X B P one. A ligase then joins the ends. Only the spliced message yields an active transcription factor.
scenes.caption: In its best-known job, IRE1 cuts a segment out of one messenger RNA. In animals, that message is XBP1. A ligase then joins the ends. Only the spliced message yields an active transcription factor.
scenes.visual: Two IRE1 blades cut the XBP1 message at both ends of a segment; the segment drops out, a ligase joins the ends, and an arrow leads to an active transcription factor, while an unspliced message gives none.
scenes.narration: In its best-known job, IRE1 cuts a segment out of one messenger RNA. In animals, that message is XBP1. A ligase then joins the ends. Only the spliced message yields an active transcription factor.

scenes.tts: Look at the piece that is removed. In X B P one it is twenty-six nucleotides. That is not a multiple of three. So the reading frame shifts, and the protein gains a new tail.
scenes.caption: Look at the piece that is removed. In XBP1 it is 26 nucleotides. That is not a multiple of three. So the reading frame shifts, and the protein gains a new tail.
scenes.visual: The message drawn as squares in groups of three with the removed piece labelled 26 nucleotides. The piece lifts out, the groups on the right regroup out of step, and the protein below gains a new tail. Marked idealised.
scenes.narration: Look at the piece that is removed. In XBP1 it is 26 nucleotides. That is not a multiple of three. So the reading frame shifts, and the protein gains a new tail.

scenes.tts: That factor orders more chaperones. Chaperones help proteins fold, so folding capacity rises. This is the repair branch. Keep this order. I R E one clusters. The message is cut and joined. The frame shifts. An active factor appears.
